capabilities: track study sessions capturing notes opened, modified and time spent per note
generate a clickable diagram and linked chain of the path through notes
write session summaries into the daily note in a marked block
generate recall questions from session notes via the Claude API
crash-save running sessions and resume them after reload
extras: Warns that the API key is stored in plain text in the plugin folder and will sync with the vault (Obsidian Sync, iCloud, git); API usage is billed to the user's own Anthropic account; installable via BRAT as a beta plugin.
problem: Obsidian's daily notes only hold what you write yourself; they don't record what you actually studied, how long, or how you moved between notes.

relations.evidence: respects your Daily Notes / Periodic Notes folder, date format and template

summary: Study session tracker that records which notes you opened, for how long and your path between them, then writes a summary into your daily note.
